b: Gram-negative bacilli; encapsulated, nonmotile, facultative anaerobes
One of most common causes of bloody diarrhoea ; humans only known reservoir
Highly transmissible by faecal-oral route or contaminated water/food
Infective dose: fewer than 100 organisms (extremely low)

snip.t: Whichone of the following is a feature of the VIPoma\ne. shigellosis is a likely diagnosis syndrome?\na.

Endemic shigellosis peaks in 1-4 yr olds, whereas Campylobacter and Cryptosporidium show a bimodal distribution with the greatest number of reported cases in infants and young children a secondary peak in adolescents and young adults.
Example: shigellosis, inflammatory bowel disease (ulcerative colitis, Crohn disease), amoebic colitis.
